rules.approvedRule: Individual initiative each round: hidden random roll 1.00–20.99 (uniform whole-number d20 outcomes with two decimal places), plus DEX modifier, minus Weapon Speed, plus applicable racial bonus. Display whole-number initiative. Minimum displayed initiative is 1: clamp the whole-number component to 1 while retaining the original roll’s fractional hundredths for ranking (e.g. an original roll of 1.27 minus 4 gives -2.73; retain the original 0.27, yielding internal 1.27, displayed 1). Keep two decimal places. Resolve exact initiative ties using a separate hidden random tie-breaker among tied combatants, rerolling if needed; this changes ordering only. Hobbits/Halflings receive +1 initiative. All other races receive no racial initiative bonus unless an explicitly approved ability grants one. Spellcasting speed penalty equals the spell’s level. Unarmed attacks have speed penalty 0. When attacking with two different weapons in the same round, use the slower weapon’s speed (the larger speed penalty). Movement, drinking a potion, turning undead, class abilities and other actions default to speed penalty 0 unless the action specifies otherwise. When a declared action changes after initiative is rolled, keep the same original random roll and recalculate initiative using the new action’s speed penalty, including the approved minimum rule. A combatant that has already acted receives no second turn.

rules.approvedRule: Link arcane spells to individual physical Spellbook volumes of 100 pages, one page per spell level; a spell must fit completely within one volume and duplicates are not recorded within a volume.
